title: Interview Pattern Fusion
description: Core concepts and hands-on practice in Interview Pattern Fusion.

topics.title: Ordered Event Lookup
topics.description: Use upper bound over timestamps/versions to retrieve the latest valid state. Includes guided dry runs, Java 17 implementation, independent practice, and interview transfer.

pages.title: Why This Topic Matters
pages.content: Use upper bound over timestamps/versions to retrieve the latest valid state.
pages.teachingGoal: Explain why Ordered Event Lookup is useful.

pages.title: Intuition
pages.content: Start from a brute-force mental model, then ask what structure lets us remove half the candidates. State the invariant before writing the loop.
pages.teachingGoal: Explain the intuition for Ordered Event Lookup.
pages.suggestedVisual: Candidate interval shrinking from two sides.

pages.title: Worked Example 1
pages.teachingGoal: Trace the first example of Ordered Event Lookup.

pages.title: Worked Example 2
pages.teachingGoal: Trace a second variation and compare its boundary rule.

pages.title: Debugging Clinic
pages.content: Test empty/small input where allowed, target at an endpoint, target absent, repeated values where relevant, and the largest numeric answer. Never change a pointer without preserving the invariant.
pages.teachingGoal: Debug common Ordered Event Lookup failures.

pages.title: Mastery Gate
pages.content: Explain the candidate space, predicate/order, boundary convention, termination, and complexity. Then solve one nearby problem without looking at the worked code.
pages.teachingGoal: Pass the mastery gate for Ordered Event Lookup.

practiceProblems.title: Time Based Key-Value Store
practiceProblems.description: For each GET query, return the value with the greatest timestamp not exceeding the query timestamp.
practiceProblems.problemStatement: For each GET query, return the value with the greatest timestamp not exceeding the query timestamp.

sampleTestCases.input:
4
SET foo bar 1
SET foo baz 4
GET foo 3
GET foo 4
sampleTestCases.explanation: At time 3 the latest valid entry is timestamp 1.
